DESIGN AND ANALYSIS OF DIRECT DRIVE COAXIAL HELICOPTER WITH OBJECT DETECTION

details.description:
ROLE: Team Leader, Designer, and Performance Analyst
• Led a diverse team in conceptualizing and developing a revolutionary direct drive coaxial helicopter with object
detection using AI for my Aeronautical Engineering final year project.
• Innovatively eliminated intermediary gear and swashplate mechanism, enabling direct motor-to-propeller power
transfer.
• Pioneered object detection technology for autonomous identification and tracking, demonstrating potential in
defense and mapping applications.
• Prioritized stability in design, resulting in an exceptionally stable platform, setting new benchmarks for unmanned
aerial systems.
• Integrated aerodynamics, control systems, and advanced materials for optimal performance, collaborating
effectively with team members.
• Conducted rigorous flight simulations, structural analysis, and CFD investigations, achieving 98% accuracy

resulting in mission success and efficiency.

projects.title: GPT-3 POWERED AI CHATBOT: TRANSFORMING INTERACTIONS

 Seamlessly linked home automation, enabling personalized control and experiences.

projects.title: THRUST VECTOR CONTROL (TVC) FOR ROCKET ENGINES

details.description:

 Led development of a 2-Axis TVC system, ensuring stability for diverse rocket engines.

 Validated system through rigorous simulations and practical testing.
 Enhanced rocket launches, demonstrating strong technical and collaborative skills.

Designed and developed an autonomous drone with Ardupilot and px4 for a prestigious college annual day event.

clear communication of complex technical concepts. Technical information effectively.

Recognized for High School Innovation at Sahyadri College of Engineering.

 Showcased project at Sahyadri College's innovation competition and secured first place at school level

details.description: Evaluated the properties of Phase Change Materials(PCM) - n-eicosane and paraffin wax, and sorted ways for thermal optimization, for cooling Lithium ion batteries. Performed battery modeling and simulations to obtain results for current drawn from battery for steady and transient loading cases.

projects.title: Life Cycle Analysis on Alternative Fuels

details.description: Performed Life Cycle Analysis(LCA) for the alternative fuel - Natural Gas, using GREET software and made a cumulative report on the same.

projects.title: Study on Vehicle Radiators and its Design

details.description: Evaluated and made a detailed report on vehicle radiators - its working principle, components, applications, and latest advancement in radiators production. Special study was done on radiator design.

Performed literature review on problem of a charged particle traversing through a lattice, subject to a magnetic field with a symmetric gauge. Solved the Schrodinger equation and obtained energy eigen values for the problem. Verified the quantization of magnetic flux, and obtained the Hofstadter’s Butterfly fractal for the model.

projects.title: Magnetic Vortex Generator for Heat Transfer Enhancement in a Wavy Mini Channel

details.description:
Performed a wavy mini channel model, and mesh using ANSYS, and performed ANSYS Fluent simulations to study how heat transfer is being enhanced (due to its apparent concentrated heat
flux) in nano fluid post vortex generation in the nanofluid (with Fe3O4 - TiO2 nanoparticles).

projects.title: De-icing of water droplet using Surface Acoustic Wave (SAW)

details.description: Study project on micro-heating of droplets using Surface Acoustic Waves. Made a cumulative report on the same after reviewing multiple research papers on de-icing

projects.title: X Ray Diffraction for Microstructure Type and Measurement of Crystallite Size

details.description: Course project - Prepared report after reviewing research papers and delivered a seminar on XRD for figuring out Microstructure Type of a material and how it is used for measuring crystallite size

projects.title: Analysis of Crack Propagation on a Copper Plate

details.description: Analysed crack formation, growth and propagation on a copper plate with Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations - LAMMPS and Ovito softwares.

projects.title: Study on Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) Supply Chain

details.description: Performed literature review and made a detailed report on HUL Supply Chain - supply chain and product configuration, strategic fit, its logistical and cross functional drivers, achievement of coordination and obstacles while achieving, and SWOT analysis of HUL Supply Chain.

projects.title: Product design and development in Financial sector

details.description: Performed SWOT Analysis on top 10 companies in financial sector. Made use of various tools equipped from manufacturing management and implemented these ideas for product development for the company JP Morgan Chase.

projects.title: Dark Matter Modeling using Gravitational Lensing

details.description: Study project - Made a cumulative report on Gravitational lensing after reviewing multiple research papers and conferences

projects.title: Fluid Structure Interaction Analysis on Aircraft Wing

details.description:
Objective is to conduct a detailed study on the variation in the results when an aircraft wing is subjected to a single mode
and a coupled mode analysis.
 Design a wing using CATIA V5. Carry out the CFD, Static Structural and modal frequency analysis on the wing and
compare it with the results obtained from the FSI analysis using ANSYS R18.1. 3 iterations was carried out by applying
3 different material.
 Result  The lift and L/D values decrease when Fluid-Structure Interaction is taken into consideration due to the
decrease in load acting on the structure because of the development of adverse pressure gradients. Since composites
have a high strength to weight ratio, they undergo the least deformation and have the ability to withstand higher stress
values.

projects.title: Developing GUI for calculating Stress, Strain, and Elongation in compound bars

details.description:
A graphical user interface was created using JAVA
 Using the formulas provided in our given prescribed textbook, the stress, strain and elongation can be calculated for
compound bars.
 Result - The program could calculate the stress, strain and elongation in compound bars having rectangular or circular
cross sections by just inputting the loads acting, the length, breadth, thickness and Young's modulus. This program thus
reduced the amount of time it would take to solve the program manually.

details.description:
Objective is to conduct a detailed study on the variation in the results when an aircraft wing is subjected to a single mode
and a coupled mode analysis.
 Design a wing using CATIA V5. Carry out the CFD, Static Structural and modal frequency analysis on the wing and

technical_papers.title: Fatigue Analysis On Wing Structure

details.description:
Designed a scaled down model (1:10) of the wing of a conventional 2-seater aircraft using CATIA V5 and conducted
fatigue analysis on ANSYS R18.1 using the static structural module.
 Performed fatigue analysis on the wing for 4 materials and 3 spar cross sections to determine its structural strength, life,
factor of safety and fatigue sensitivity.
 Result - Composites have high strength to weight ratio which assist in designing light weight structures without
compromising on the strength. Observed the variation in results when the spar cross section is changed which indicates
its role in increasing the structural integrity of the structure.

projects.title: Detection of Pleural Effusion on Chest X-Ray

details.description:
• Developed a model that worked on top of InceptionV3, trained on Stanford ML Group’s CheXPert
dataset to classify Chest X-Ray images that show the presence of Pleural Effusion.
• The model achieved a validation accuracy of 93%.
• This research also included a comparative study that compared models that worked on top of
ResNet50 and DenseNet121, where InceptionV3 outperformed both.

• On a given set of inputs such as median income of the block, house age, average number of
rooms, population of the block, etc. the tool can predict the cost of a house.
• The cost of the house is predicted with certain degree of confidence and a range.

• Smooth, user-friendly and mobile optimized UI, robust Node.js back-end and NoSQL database.

details.description:
While for well-graded soil , the lime percentage used were
0.0%, 1.0%, 2.0%, and 3.0% by dry weight of soil. The hole erosion test
was utilized to analyze the erosion parameters of the soil sample. Results
proved that lime is an effective soil stabilization agent against the internal
erosion of sandy soil.

work_experiences.job_description:
• Migrated and improved an AI Grant application analysis application from monolith to microservices using Go, MongoDB, MySQL, and React.
• Created a custom form builder with features such as data validation, conditional logic, and Wle uploads.
• Wrote complex SQL zueries and monitored their performance.
• Worked with Auth0 API to provide multiple functionalities like managing the organization and its members.
• Collaborated with UI/UX designers to create pixel-perfect user interfaces.

• Developed a COVID-19 vaccination application used by pharmacies in the /S to vaccinate over 1M people in 
Washington and Arizona.
• Reduced operational costs by 80% by introducing caching and performance optimization.
• Guaranteed 100 API uptime during high traffi by introducing caching.
• Developed an application for the San Diego County Office of Education to verify the authenticity of PDF 
transcripts using blockchain.
• Contributed to the feature deployment and release process

vulnerabilities can offer malicious actors significant leverage in the dynamic landscape of digital
warfare, emphasizing the need for robust cybersecurity measures.

projects.title: Modeling of Carbon dioxide based supercritical natural circulation Loop

details.description: Design of NCL using carbon dioxide as working fluid in supercritical stage.

technical_papers.title: Dynamic model of supercritical CO2 based natural circulation loops with fixed charge

details.description: A dynamic model of natural circulation loops (NCLs) using supercritical carbon dioxide as working fluid is presented. An NCL with constant mass of working fluid is considered. The mathematical model is developed by considering 1-D balance equations for mass, momentum and energy, duly considering the variation in the properties of the CO2. Method of lines is used to convert the partial differential equations into ordinary differential equations in time and a finite volume method is used for spatial discretization. Modelica language is used to develop a generic dynamic model of the NCL which allows for an easy change in the loop configuration and also implementation of control systems. The results from the model developed showed good agreement with the experimental studies reported in literature on an air cooled supercritical CO2 based NCL. Results show that wall thermal capacitance is an important factor to be considered in the dynamical analysis of the NCL as it suppresses oscillations during loop transients and increases the time required to reach steady state. When operated under fixed mass of working fluid, the mass flow rate of the NCL at steady state increases monotonically with heat input without exhibiting any maximum.
